name: TCL Industries Holdings Co., Ltd.
note: Holding company created in TCL's 2019 corporate restructuring, when the group separated into TCL Technology and TCL Industries; it holds about 54.54% of TCL Electronics through T.C.L. Industries (H.K.). Its own shareholders are not named in the sources opened; media reporting on a 2026 transaction (36kr/Damo Finance, 2026-07-17) describes founder Li Dongsheng as the actual controller of TCL Electronics through TCL Industries and says the 2019 restructuring introduced CITIC Industrial Fund as a shareholder of TCL Industries.
